versionGroups.label: Shared React runtime — every workspace must agree. @righton/networking declares these as peerDependencies and ships React components, so a range split can resolve to two physical copies, which breaks hooks and MUI/styled-components context at runtime. Type-checking and building cannot detect this.
Everything else — drift tolerated pending a separate dependency modernization pass (storybook 7→8, host_v2 typescript 4→5, play swiper 9→11, prettier 2→3).
